Elaine (Product): Heads-up — we've got two enterprise pilots asking for higher sustained throughput without changing model weight. Can we sketch a packaging path for a throughput-focused add-on?
Sam R (Sales): +1 on pilots. They want a contractual guarantee for sustained 250 QPS over 8h windows. Main ask is predictability during promos.
Mike T (Eng): 250 QPS sustained is doable but requires reserved capacity + controlled autoscaling. Need to be explicit about burst vs sustained and how KV prefix cache interacts.
Anya (Finance): From revenue side, customers prefer a simple addon SKU vs custom reserved contracts. We should figure price per reserved-GPU-hour or a flat "throughput booster" monthly fee.
Jordan (Solutions): For pilots we can offer a time-limited addon: "Throughput Booster — Pilot". Must include rollout criteria: successful synthetic run, perf regression <2%, and failover playbook.
pricing-bot: snapshot: pilot_customer_A — avg tokens/s 320, p95 latency 210ms, current GA capacity insufficient for sustained 250 QPS without dedicated pool.
Elaine (Product): Proposed scope: addon unlocks dedicated reserved pool with priority routing + SLA for sustained throughput windows. Questions: billing shape (commit vs meter) and limits (caps per account).
Sam R (Sales): Customers will accept a monthly commit if price delta vs on-demand < 40%. Also want a clear overage policy (throttled vs billed).
Mike T (Eng): Implementation constraints: dedicated pool requires model pinning for compat kernels, and autoscaler needs distinct policy per customer. ETA for infra work ~6 weeks for MVP, 10 wks for hardened rollouts.
Anya (Finance): Recommend hybrid billing: monthly reserved credit (committed hours) + overage billing at premium rate. That simplifies forecasting and keeps price anchor.
Jordan (Solutions): Launch gating checklist (suggested):
- Pilot completion: 2 customers hitting 72h sustained windows
- Perf guardrails: token cost within 15% of baseline with config X
- Observability: per-route token & latency dashboards in Console
- Docs: quickstart for switching routes to addon
Elaine (Product): Agree with gating. Also need contract language: guaranteed sustained throughput windows, SLAs tied to routing priority, and explicit auto-fallback to standard tier with notice.
Sam R (Sales): Legal will push for credits, not monetary refunds. Let's draft SLO credits tied to minutes of degraded sustained throughput.
Mike T (Eng): One more flag: KV cache warm-up can cause transient drops. Need to document expected warm-up and add a recommended warm start procedure in the onboarding playbook.
Anya (Finance): Pricing proposal: option A — monthly commit $X per reserved-GPU-hour; option B — flat addon $Y/month for up to N sustained QPS; overage at 1.8x on-demand rate. (I'll put numbers after ops estimates).
Elaine (Product): Action items: Mike to validate infra ETA and ops runbook (due EOW). Anya to produce two priced proposals with ARR math. Jordan to draft pilot runbook. Sam to line up customer pilots who can commit to test windows. Legal to prepare SLO credit terms.
Sam R (Sales): I'll confirm Pilot A & B by Wednesday.
Mike T (Eng): I'll post infra design and config snippet. Example policy:
```
route: throughput-booster
pool: reserved-customer-1
autoscale: min_instances:4; max_instances:12
prio: high
```
Jordan (Solutions): I'll add warm-start checklist to the runbook and a short troubleshooting table for common perf regressions.
Elaine (Product): Great — let's reconvene Friday for a short sync with the proposed numbers and infra plan. :thumbsup:
